reviewed.reason: Transitive pySigma requirement. AEGIS uses bounded in-memory SigmaCollection parsing plus explicit local checks of the parsed model/conditions. No sigma.validators.core, DiskCache import, instance or cache directory is used. Regression tests and audit exercise parsing and analysis, including invalid conditions, and require diskcache absent from sys.modules. Runtime filesystem is read-only. Enabling pySigma validators, plugins, data loaders or caching requires fresh review.
